facts.fact: Xavier 书里掉出两张照片（背面手写）：Il Dolce Far Niente – Australia Immaginaria / Chi va piano, va sano e va lontano——同为 Four Mile Beach, Port Douglas, June 20, 2003；意大利语课：The sweetness of doing nothing（她：那不是我的习惯——I'm always working）＋「He who goes slowly, goes safely and goes far」（她：beautiful photo—beguiling portrait of life）；Four Mile Beach＝Cairns 以北约一小时车程——「When I look at this photograph, it gives me a glimpse of happiness. I feel a surge of possibility … My future starts now!」（uncharacteristic burst of optimism——不想吓到你）；二十岁的「pleasure of possibility/bravado of youth——endless possibility has its limits」；「You were so much fun back then – you were game for anything」→「You still have the capacity for fun」。

facts.fact: 辞职抉择：读着读着心神漂移——「A plan was formulating in my brain」；8 月 1 日本该回去上班——「What if I handed in my resignation then? Would I feel free or bereft?」→I would feel free；教授梦清算：18 岁爱上「教授的浪漫」——长大后才知代价＝management role＋preside over 无人想开的会＋裁掉系里三分之一员工——「But what if I backed myself and cast caution to the four winds?」→That could work；旅行的疗效清单：Rome revelatory、十年如绷紧弹簧后终于放松（work pressures＋relationship issues）、与你不期而遇的 serendipity——「I can be myself with you – I don't have to pretend...I can say stupid things, and you won't judge me, because you love me … or at the very least, you like me and you understand me and you are on my side」。
facts.anchor: Would I feel free or bereft?

facts.fact: 单身一年的初次疗程：前六个月 unexpectedly blissful——听自己想听的、看自己想看的、不必 compromise、可以彻底 selfish and self-centred（that was okay）；revitalisation 中找到女 shrink＝Lacanian psychoanalyst——revelation：童年话题打开（「the essential loneliness of growing up in the countryside came into view」）＋可在安全空间谈 malfunctioning amatory relationships；灾难恋爱史第一章＝最后一个同居者倒叙。

瑞士人 Rudolph（她戏称 swish national）：NGV 的 Guggenheim 巡展 Rothko 前搭话（Do you like it? I love it）——会员区喝咖啡；一周后 path of least resistance 搬进 St Kilda 两居室（Port Phillip Bay 景、免租）——起初自夸 decisive、seizing the day——几个月后惊觉 huge mistake；自己公寓已出租一年＝被陌生人困住十个月（想攒买房首付）；「Financially the deal worked out very well for me, but emotionally … not so well」；Rudolph 讨厌 Rudy 昵称（每个澳洲人都这么叫）；neatness freak、upper hand（他的公寓）——「Such a strange word – apartment – a series of rooms that keep people apart」；她习惯同时读六本书、随手乱放——他按作者姓氏重排书架（annoyed me no end——「he wanted to be in control of every little thing」）。
facts.anchor: his offer had come at a moment of weakness

facts.fact: Rudolph 罪状清单：神秘职业（早出晚归每周五天、拒谈工作——international man of mystery）；razor-sharp mind——「it can cut you and wound you」；嫌她的朋友（起外号 Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer/Red/Rusty、永远开玩笑）；他自己没朋友；抱怨澳洲人 too flippant、无人讨论 world politics、「for many Australians the wider world didn't exist」；她逐渐不再邀他、夜里少陪——最终 sickening feeling：这个住在海景公寓的帅哥「had no sense of humour」；当初为何选他：直觉他会 keep me on the straight and narrow、curb my impulsive behaviour——确实高效执行、她深深怨恨——「I didn't really want my behaviour to be curbed at all...I was used to my freedom」；入住条款：至少一年（foolishly agreed——moment of weakness）；湿毛巾事件（cloth-covered couches）＝他 batshit crazy 的导火索（irrationally angry at such a trivial offence）——「it was his apartment and I would follow his rules」。

出走与购房：六个月忍无可忍、初夏搬出（St Kilda 最好的季节）——最后三个月只当睡觉的地方、先住朋友家、六个月后 Brunswick 公寓腾出——rebound 中 impulsively 买下 North Fitzroy 的 tumble-down worker's cottage：正面 cute、后面 hideous、lean-to 需重建——后院十丛 topiary balls 失控、园艺师报价每丛 100 刀修成网球形（ridiculous sum for a bush-haircut）——叙述者认领修剪任务（「Men can be useful sometimes. Usually men are simply annoying, but every now and then …」）；护照揭底：袜屉里的护照——Rudy 是德国人不是瑞士人！拒答、改聊墨尔本天气（four seasons in one day）；他的欧洲 punctuality 论（Why can't the seasons behave as they do in Europe...in Melbourne the weather is topsy-turvy – you never know what to wear）。
facts.anchor: ten bushes that were once topiary balls

facts.fact: 不想下车：「I don't want this train journey to end...this endless parade of images out my window...I like talking with you」；旅行把她从 slumber 唤醒（more alive、more aware of surroundings）——「I'm becoming much more sensate with each passing moment – every day we human working machines have become so denatured and so enervated by quotidian reality」；Four Mile Beach 游泳须知：highrisk 暖季只在被网围住处游——stingers 不咬、咸水鳄不吃；iPod Nano 播放 The National 的专辑《Alligator》。
facts.anchor: so denatured and so enervated by quotidian reality
